economic_rationale: Broad equity index ETFs exhibit persistent medium-horizon trends driven by slow capital reallocation and flows; holding the risk asset only while its price is above a long moving average should avoid the deepest drawdowns of sustained bear phases, at the cost of whipsaw exits near turning points. The counterparty view is that month-end lag and whipsaws give back most of the trend benefit; the fixed OOS interval will decide.
rule_pseudocode: On the last open session of month M: closes = known closes of XSHG:510300 through T; if len(closes) < N: NO_DECISION(INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY); sma = mean(last N closes); if close_T > sma: TARGETS XSHG:510300 weight 1.0; else TARGETS XSHG:510300 weight 0.0 (explicit cash exit).
parameter_rationale: Predeclared priority, not return-optimized: the shortest admitted window (150) reacts earliest to regime change and is tried first; each longer window is a slower, more conservative fallback. No grid search beyond the three M1-D02 windows.

universe_policy.formation_rule: Fixed frozen view of M0-qualified broad-based equity ETF XSHG:510300 for the whole run; no reconstitution, no future membership backfill.

benchmark.rationale: Same-ETF buy-and-hold through the same M0 kernel isolates the timing decision from asset exposure; benchmark is pre-registered before any result.

risk_off_rationale: M1-D04: CASH is the zero-yield account cash and is deliberately chosen over a defensive ETF; bond/gold exposure is never substituted for cash by this candidate.
basic_promotion_rationale: Fail-closed pre-registered gate: full-window NAV coverage, total return within 5pp of the same-ETF buy-and-hold, maximum drawdown no deeper than -40%, and cumulative half-gross turnover at most 12x average equity. No threshold is tuned after results are seen; a variant that fails writes REJECTED_BASIC and stops.
oos_survivor_rationale: Survivor means 'worth M2 robustness validation', not tradability: same benchmark-relative return floor and drawdown ceiling as Basic, applied to the fixed OOS interval only.
known_limitations: Monthly cadence misses intra-month reversals; whipsaw exits near V-shaped turns are expected.
SMA trend rules are sensitive to the warm-up window; only the frozen 2015-01-05 warm-up is used.
CASH_0 ignores any money-market yield; the comparison is conservative for carry.
Basic snapshot physically ends at 2022-12-30; the fixed OOS request 2023-01-03..2025-12-31 stays unrevealed until after freeze.
source: M1 protocol section 7.2 owner-approved seed candidate; no external code or text copied.
